findings.finding: The outbound diff ADDs every local release missing from Jira with no intent check. The label path the plan says it follows also checks the ADD: _diff_labels skips an ADD for a tag that is not in intent_set (the T4 IB-REMOVE regression, bug a06c). Without that check, a Jira-side removal of a fix version that reached rebar inbound is undone every pass. The local ticket holds the inbound-applied name and the intent set excludes it, but the outbound diff emits ADD anyway. Because outbound wins same-pass conflicts, that ADD suppresses the inbound REMOVE and re-adds the version to Jira. Once a Jira-originated release has synced, Jira can never remove it.

findings.finding: The plan adds add_fix_version/remove_fix_version to the TicketTransport protocol body, but conformance is not defined by that body. Both isinstance(x, TicketTransport) and assert_transport_conforms check the module-level tuple _REQUIRED_TRANSPORT_MEMBERS (_backend.py:104-124), which the plan never mentions. Unless that tuple is updated too, a backend without the new verbs still passes the construction-time guard.
